blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of the East ended the first round of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament without a win. UE coach Paolo Hubalde, though, wasn’t too concerned about the record. Instead, he is focused on how his Red Warriors can improve. “I don’t see any problem but we really need to improve,” he told the Inquirer. “We’re still lacking because our efforts aren’t translating to wins. We have to go back to basics and put more hard work in.” ‘I DON’T SEE ANY PROBLEM BUT WE NEED TO IMPROVE’ WATCH: UE […]...
